subject: ACME POC: access, success criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T15:24:00-07:00
Subject: ACME POC: access, success criteria & next steps

Hi Alex —

Great to meet you and Emily on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before provisioning access for the POC.

POC goal / success criteria (as discussed):
- Integrate Redwood API with ACME ingestion pipeline and score results on the 3 sample datasets (Revenue.csv, SupportTickets.json, ProductFAQs.csv).
- Latency target: 95th percentile < 500ms for our batched endpoint under test load (~50 req/s).
- Cost target: <= $0.003 per 1k tokens during the evaluation window (approx).
- Quality metrics: precision@5 >= 0.78 on the ranking task; fuzzy match >= 0.82 on FAQ retrieval test.

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Day 0 (this week): Provide access (API key) + IP allowlist + SSO invite.
- Day 1-3: Baseline integration + smoke tests with sample datasets.
- Day 4-10: Load tests + metric collection; iterate on batching/quantization settings.
- Day 11: Debrief and decision call.

Ownership / contacts:
- Redwood POC lead: me (Marissa Cole) — account questions, timelines, procurement checkpoints.
- Redwood SE: Vivek Kulkarni — integration, infra, SSO.
- ACME POC lead: Alex Johnson; Security/SAML: Emily Sanchez.

Access asks (to help us provision quickly):
1) SSO: Do you plan to onboard users via SAML SSO or would you prefer to use a short-lived API key for the initial run? If SAML, please share the IdP metadata (or add vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com as the SP contact).
2) IP allowlist: Please confirm the public IPs or ranges we should allow for API access (we can also support CIDR).
3) Contacts: Please confirm who should receive the API key and SSO invite (Emily or another admin).

Attachments: POC-plan.pdf (high-level timeline & evaluation checklist).

Planned next steps from our side once we have the above: create API credential, send a secure one-time download link, open ticket with infra to add IP allowlist, and send SSO invite if you provide metadata.

Would you be able to send the SAML metadata and IP list today? If not, we can provision an API key within 24 hours to get you started.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0183
